Shaped iteration 0110 as one independent review of #544's WP1 project-text writing proposal.
[Prior report](history/sessions/544/908fb5d0861e7178ef0b5f2ec23acdaefb5027fea533245950663b4d629a6b96.md) and its [proposal](../benchmark/project-text-writing-0109.md) establish that preparation is ready for review; routine merge did not accept the method.
[Task graph](tasks.json) assigns reviewer/default/high, 90 minutes and 70 turns, with no dependencies.
The review pins the baseline and accepted candidate, checks original-source locators and preservation, exercises rejection controls, and assesses W1–W8 and narrative claims.
Its outputs are a scoped recommendation and a hashed session artifact; the reviewer reports without fixing repository files.
Verification is `python3 benchmark/scripts/check_project_text_writing_0109.py`; control counts must come from actual files.
Read the graph back and checked its JSON structure, role, sections, limits and empty dependency list; no shell verification is available to this role.
[Working memory](../journal/working-memory.md) now records #544's accepted delivery, pending review, evidence boundaries and resume instructions.
Startup diagnostics were ok: estimated 13,837 tokens. All declared startup documents were read once.
No LabVIEW session can run here; native behavior and save-version preservation remain unverified, and owner method acceptance remains outstanding.
## What next
Read iteration 0110's reviewer report and actual artifact. Preserve exact review bytes through a permitted writer before qualified integration, or correct only evidenced findings and re-review.
Keep pending #532 separate. Avoid repeating #541/#493 probes, source discovery or POC preparation without new evidence.
